Deep ones! If you hide from them, make a Sneak (-2) check. If you fight, make a Fight (-2) check. If you fail whichever check you attempt, lose 2 Stamina and 2 Sanity. If you pass, draw 1 Unique Item as you escape in the midst of all the chaos.

In a large round room with a glass ceiling, you are startled to discover an elderly man wearing exotic robes. He tells you that the gods have decreed that he should meet you in this strange place. If you are Cursed or have any Mask items, he tells you that he is called The Messenger and is meant to aid you. Take his Ally card or, if it is not available, gain 2 Clue tokens.
set_labels: Miskatonic Horror: Curse of the Dark Pharaoh component

location_encounters.text: It's easy to get separated in the winding tunnels. Return one Ally of your choice to the box. If do not have any Allies, nothing happens.
Move quickly, or you'll be surrounded before you can escape with your prize! Pass a Speed (-1) check to draw a Unique Item. If you fail, you are devoured.

On the far side of this cavern is a glittering idol that you're certain is important, if only you can reach it. Make a Sneak (-2) check. If you pass, you may take your choice of 1 Unique Item or 3 Clue tokens. If you fail, you lose 1 Sanity and 1 Stamina, move to the first area of R'lyeh and are delayed.

Representatives from the Cult of the Black Goat are here to learn more of the Deep Ones! You may join the cult if you wish. To do so, you must discard at least 2 toughness worth of monster trophies, lose 3 Stamina, or discard an ally. Take a "One of the Thousand" Cult Membership Card. If you cannot or choose not to join, pass a Speed (-2) check or lose 2 Stamina.
set_labels: Miskatonic Horror: The Black Goat of the Woods component

location_encounters.text: Several of the fish creatures are trying to chase you toward a pool of strange dark water. Make a Speed (-1) check to prevent yourself from being forced into the pool. If you fail, move to the first area of R'lyeh and you are delayed.
Strangely, you feel you know exactly how to navigate the twisting caverns to find the object you are sinking. Gain 1 Unique Item and draw 1 Innsmouth Look card.
The air-filled cavern you're in begins to fill with water as the tide shifts. You lose 1 Stamina and are delayed as you wait it out.

The creatures are engaged in some sort of ritual! You are immediately sucked through the open gate with the most difficult modifier (your choice if there are two equally difficult gates). If there are no open gates, nothing happens.
The deep ones are everywhere! Make a Fight (-1) check to barricade the hallway. If you fail, lose 2 Stamina struggling to escape the creatures.
The walls are covered with strange luminescent moss and lichens. You feel prolonged exposure to them is having a bad effect on you. Lose 1 Stamina.
The writing etched into the wall is looking more and more familiar. Gain 1 Spell and draw 1 Innsmouth Look card.
set_labels: Miskatonic Horror: The Lurker at the Threshold component

location_encounters.text: Two of the creatures walk past you carrying a large chest. Make a Sneak (-2) check. If you pass, you follow them and discover where they leave it. Gain 1 Unique Item from inside the chest once the creatures leave. If you fail, lose 1 Stamina as they roughly toss you aside.

You are overcome with a sense of fate, knowing that it was your destiny to be in this strange place. Make a Will (-1) check. If you pass, you realize that you will play a special role in saving the world. You may take the Anointed card if it is available. If you fail, you fear that you are doomed to die here. Lose 1 Sanity.
set_labels: Miskatonic Horror: Curse of the Dark Pharaoh component

location_encounters.text: You desperately flee from pursuing deep ones and, with no other choice, leap into a dark, unexplored cavern. Make a Luck (-1) check. If you pass, move to Devil Reef. If you fail, you are lost in time and space.

You discover a chamber filled with scrolls, ancient tomes, and engraved stonework. Make a Luck (-2) check. If you pass, you stumble upon useful ancient knowledge. You may draw 2 Spells, choose 1 to keep and discard the other. If you fail, you stumble upon a terrible ancient evil. You are Cursed.
You feel as though being in these underground caves is reinvigorating you. Gain 1 Stamina and draw one Innsmouth Look card.
You find a curious doorway. If you pass through it, move to the Esoteric Order of Dagon and have an encounter there.

You find a statue of Dagon, as large as a house, covered in strange writing. You fear that just being in its presence is dangerous. Make a Lore (-2) check as you look at the writing. Gain 1 Clue token for each success. If you gained 3 or more Clue tokens, you are Cursed.

You find an abandoned temple. At the front, resting on an altar is a copy of the Ponape Scripture. Pass a Lore (-2) check to gain some useful insight from the book. If you succeed, you may close one gate to R'lyeh anywhere on the board. Keep the gate trophy and remove monsters with the matching dimensional symbol as normal.

You find precious golden jewelry, far more than you can carry. You may stop to collect some. If you do, make a Fight (+1) check and gain $1 for each success. You are delayed as you gather up all the loot.
You inadvertently fall into one of the pools of water. Make a Speed (-1) check to get out before you are swarmed by Deep Ones. If you fail, lose 2 Stamina before you pull yourself back into the air.
set_labels: Miskatonic Horror: The King in Yellow component

location_encounters.text: You see a large painting that you recognize as a map of the ocean floor. You can identify the city of Y'ha-nthlei on the map and see several other similar cities represented as well. Make a Lore (-2) check and gain 1 Clue token for each success. If you get no successes, lose 2 Sanity.
set_labels: Miskatonic Horror: The Lurker at the Threshold component

location_encounters.text: You sense powerful, ancient voice attempt flood your mind with terrible thoughts. Pass a Will (-2) check or lose 2 Sanity.
You step out onto a balcony overlooking thousands of these fish creatures, all chanting and bowing before an image of Dagon. Make a Will (-2) check. If you fail, lose 2 Sanity.
set_labels: Miskatonic Horror: The Black Goat of the Woods component

location_encounters.text: You try to recall every scrap of information you learned about this place to prevent these creatures from running rampant. If you have 2 or fewer Clue tokens, add 1 Uprising token to the Deep Ones Rising track.
set_labels: Miskatonic Horror: The King in Yellow component

location_encounters.text: You've been down here so long you fear you're losing your sense of reality and your sense of self. You must either lose 2 Sanity or draw 1 Innsmouth Look card.

You've got the proof you need, now all you have to do is escape this terrible place! Pass a Luck (-1) [2] check to move to Falcon Point, then remove all tokens from both the Feds Raid Innsmouth and the Deep Ones Rising tracks. In addition, remove 1 doom token from the doom track. If you fail, you are devoured.

Your foot slips on one of the damp ledges and you go tumbling down a steep incline. Make a Luck (-1) check. If you pass, you end up landing right next to a rare and powerful artifact. Search the Unique Item deck and take the first Weapon you find. If you fail, you land on a bunch of rocks. Lose 2 Stamina.

"Ah, there you are. That item you ordered has come in." Oddly enough, you ordered no such item. If you wish, you may make a Will (-2) check to impersonate the rightful owner. If you pass, you may draw 1 Unique Item. If you fail, you are arrested.

A famous occultist is in town giving a lecture. As part of his demonstration he offers to place you in a trance. If you agree, make a Will (-2) check. Gain 1 Clue token for each success. if you fail the check, lose 1 Sanity as you are assailed by traumatic visions from your subconscious.
set_labels: The Black Goat of the Woods

location_encounters.text: A group of concerned citizens have come to harangue the proprietor and customers of the Magic Shoppe. You can calm them down with a Will (-2) check. If you succeed, empty the Outskirts returning all monsters in it to the cup. If you fail, the terror level is increased by 1.

A smiling man greets you warmly. "It's nice to see you again!" You believe he has you mistaken for someone else, but he responds, "Nonsense! I've been meaning to return this to you." He hands you a package and leaves. Gain 1 Common Item.
set_labels: The Black Goat of the Woods

location_encounters.text: A strange man roams the aisles looking desperately for something, muttering to himself. Make a Speed (-1) check, or he catches you watching him and attacks! Pass a Fight (+0) check to fend him off, or lose 1 Stamina.
set_labels: Curse of the Dark Pharaoh (Revised Edition)

location_encounters.text: As you begin to delve into the rare manuscripts, the proprietor of the shop coughs loudly and holds out his hand. You may pay $5 to search the Spell deck for a Spell.
As you enter the Magick Shoppe, Miriam Beecher doesn't even look up. "Sorry, we're closed right now. I'm performing a cleansing of the store. You'll have to leave." Move to the street.

As you wait in line to buy something, a swindler with scars on his face and a strange accent gives you a wink, then steps in front of you and begins to distract the shopkeeper. If you leave without paying, draw 1 Exhibit Item or Unique Item, but you are Cursed.
set_labels: Curse of the Dark Pharaoh (Revised Edition)

location_encounters.text: Behind a bookshelf, you hear a woman whisper, "I have killed him I loved; the world's athirst, now let it drink." When you look down that aisle, there's no one there, but there is an item resting on the floor. Draw 1 Unique Item. You may purchase it for half list price (round up).

Customers in the store are gossiping about a recent strange occurrence, and who or what may have caused it. Turn the top card of a location of your choice faceup. The next investigator to have an encounter at that location draws that card.
Looking closely at a mummified head in the shop, you are horrified to find it looking back at you! Lose 1 Sanity.

Looking into a glass ball, you receive a vision of things to come. Turn the top card of one location deck of your choice face up. The next investigator to have an encounter at that location draws that encounter card.
Miriam Beecher claims to have a healing salve in stock and offers to sell you some. You may spend $3 to recover up to 2 Stamina.
set_labels: The Black Goat of the Woods

location_encounters.text: Miriam Beecher eyes you carefully. "Hmm, if we're going to survive, I'd better teach you this." Draw 2 Spells, keeping 1 and discarding the other.
Miriam Beecher looks deep into your heart. "Prove to me your courage and I'll do what I can to aid you." For every monster trophy you have, gain 1 Stamina or 1 Sanity.
Miriam Beecher looks up as you enter the shop. "It's about time you arrived. I have a job for you to do." Take the first Mission from the Unique Item deck.

Miriam Beecher offers to cast a particularly potent and dangerous spell for you...for a price. If you are willing, spend $5 then draw a monster at random from the monster cup. If it has a moon dimensional symbol, discard it and draw again. Otherwise, return that monster and all monsters that share its dimensional symbol to the cup.
Miriam Beecher offers to cleanse your aura and restore your mental well-being, for a price. If you discard 1 Unique Item and pay $3, you are Blessed.
Miriam Beecher offers to teach you the spell you need. You may pay $5 to search the Spell deck and take any one card you want. If you turn down her offer, nothing happens.
Miriam Beecher offers to teach you the spell you need. You may pay $5 to search the Spell deck and take any one card you want. If you turn down her offer, nothing happens.
Miriam Beecher offers to teach you the spell you need. You may pay $5 to search the Spell deck and take any one Spell you want. If you turn down her offer, nothing happens.
set_labels: The Black Goat of the Woods

location_encounters.text: Miriam Beecher offers to trade spells with you. You may discard 1 Spell to draw a new one from the Spell deck.
Miriam Beecher talks to you for awhile, explaining some very interesting theories she has concerning the Mythos. Gain 1 Clue token.

Miriam Beecher, the shopkeeper, peers closely at your face, then screams, "They've marked you! Get out! Get out!" and throws you out. Move to the street and lose 1 Sanity from this unsettling incident.

Miriam Beecher thrusts a book into your hands. Taking a cursory glance through it, you notice that several pages are blank. She explains that a dark presence is erasing the knowledge it contains. Take a number of Clue tokens equal to six minus the number of elder sign tokens on the board.

Miriam looks into your face, and you feel as though you're being judged. "I see. Your heart is in the right place. Tell me of your travels, and perhaps I can help you in return." Gain 1 Clue token for every gate trophy you have.

No one is manning the shop, but an intriguing item is sitting on the counter. Draw 1 Unique Item. You may either discard it, keep it and pay its list price, or keep it without paying for it and be Cursed.
Pass a Lore (-1) check to recognize an item that Miriam Beecher has underpriced. If you do so, draw 1 Unique Item. You may purchase it for half its list price (rounded up).

Speaking with Miriam Beecher, she tells you she would be willing to trade for items, if you have anything of interest. Look at the top card of the Unique Item deck. If you want to keep it, discard one of your Unique Items or Spells.
The item you have been hoping to purchase has already been sold. Make a Sneak (-1) check to sneak a peek at the ledger to see who purchased it. If you pass, gain 2 Clue tokens.

There is an old, locked trunk for sale for $5. If you buy it, make a Luck (+0) check and consult the chart below:

Successes:
:0) Empty!
:1) Gold coins! Roll 2 dice, add them together, and gain that much money.
:2+) Jackpot! Draw 2 Unique Items!
Upon discovering a severed - but twitching - hand, you find yourself trapped in an interminable time loop. You are delayed.

Water damage! In order to unload damaged books, the shop is holding a sale. For every $1 you pay, you may draw 1 Unique Item. You may keep any Tomes that you draw, and must discard the rest. You must pay the total up front, before you draw.
set_labels: Curse of the Dark Pharaoh (Revised Edition)

location_encounters.text: With the "Legacy of the Pharaohs" exhibit in town, folks are crazy for faux-Egyptian trinkets. Pay $3 if you'd like to buy one, then make a Luck (-1) check. If you pass, it's actually a real item! Draw 1 Exhibit Item or Unique Item.
set_labels: Curse of the Dark Pharaoh (Revised Edition)

location_encounters.text: While discussing magic with Miriam Beecher, you mention a spell she doesn't know and is eager to learn! You may discard 1 spell to draw 2 unique items. Choose 1 to keep, discarding the other.

You accidentally bump into a glass bottle filled with a strange grey powder. Make a Speed (-2) check to catch it before it breaks. If you fail, lose 1 Stamina as you break out into a fit of unexplained sneezing and itching.
You know what you are looking for, but the trick will be finding it. Pass a Luck (-2) check to search the Unique Item deck for the Livre d'Ivon card.

You peek into the back room and see Miriam Beecher, the shopkeeper, unwrapping a mummy stolen from the visiting museum exhibit! If you turn her in, the Sheriff rewards you with a license to investigate as you see fit; take the Private Investigator card. However, Miriam's neighbors think you betrayed her, and you are Barred from Uptown.

You peek into the back room and see Miriam Beecher, the shopkeeper, unwrapping a mummy stolen from the visiting museum exhibit! If you turn her in, the Sheriff rewards you with a license to investigate as you see fit; take the Private Investigator card, if it is available. However, Miriam's neighbors think you betrayed her. Place a Patrol marker in the street area of Uptown.
set_labels: Curse of the Dark Pharaoh (Revised Edition)

location_encounters.text: You see an interesting book sitting open on Miriam Beecher's desk. Pass a Lore (-1) check or you peer closely at its pages only to realize too late that the book is Cursed... and now, so are you.

mythos_cards.title: A Dark Wind Covers Arkham
mythos_cards.text: The terror level increases by 1. The maximum Stamina of all investigators in Arkham is reduced by 1. Horror checks in Arkham are made at a -2 penalty.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Inky clouds blow in from the east, bringing with them sickness and fear.

mythos_cards.title: A New Dawn!
mythos_cards.text: Each investigator who is currently at 2 or less Sanity gains 1 Sanity. Each investigator who is currently at 2 or less Stamina gains 1 Stamina.

mythos_cards.title: A Sandstorm!?
mythos_cards.text: Investigators must spend 2 additional movement points to enter any location marked with a green diamond. While this card is in play, instead of having an Arkham Encounter, any investigator in a street area may pass a Luck (-1) check to draw 1 Exhibit Item.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Against all reason, a sandstorm comes up out of nowhere and strikes Arkham, clogging the streets and burying whole buildings! Strangely, it seems to avoid certain places with dark reputations.

mythos_cards.title: A Strange Plague
mythos_cards.text: Investigators cannot gain Stamina except by receiving medical care in St. Mary's Hospital (or from Vincent Lee).

mythos_cards.title: Aldeberan Ascendant
mythos_cards.text: Flying creatures do not move to the sky. Gates to Another Dimension cannot be closed or sealed.

mythos_cards.title: Alien Technology
mythos_cards.text: Mi-Go have their toughness increased by 2. If an investigator passes a Combat check against a Mi-Go, he draws 1 extra Unique Item.

mythos_cards.title: All Quiet in Arkham!
mythos_cards.text: Each player may pass a Luck (-1) check to be Blessed.

sections.Clarification: Despite the name of the card, investigators in other worlds too may try to pass the check.

mythos_cards.title: Along Came Jones
mythos_cards.text: The first investigator who ends his movement in the Train Station draws 1 Ally, then discards this card from play.

mythos_cards.title: Amnesiac Professor's Memory Returns!
mythos_cards.text: Place 2 Clue tokens in each location with an elder sign.

mythos_cards.title: An Evil Fog
mythos_cards.text: Will checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Sneak checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. Fliers do not move.

mythos_cards.title: Angry Red Skies
mythos_cards.text: Will checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Lore checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. Fliers do not move to or from the Sky.

mythos_cards.title: Another Time, Another Place!
mythos_cards.text: Every open gate leading to Another Dimension or Another Time releases one monster into its location.

mythos_cards.title: Balmy
mythos_cards.text: Sneak checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Fight checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. When moving, stalkers move to investigators in street areas or unstable locations up to 2 spaces away.

mythos_cards.title: Bank Foreclosure
mythos_cards.text: Any investigators in Arkham with Bank Loans must pay them off immediately. You may sell items at half their list price (round down) if you do not have the $10; if you cannot or will not pay, you are arrested.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: An archaeological expedition to Egypt sponsored by the bank has disappeared without a trace ... which means no returns on the bank's investment. Concerned for their savings, townsfolk rush the bank to withdraw their funds.

mythos_cards.title: Bank Targeted By Grifters
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place 1 Clue token on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play).
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If an investigator who either is the Deputy of Arkham or has a Sheldon Gang Membership (from the Dunwich Horror expansion) discards 3 Clue tokens while at the Bank of Arkham, return this card to the box. Each investigator then gains $10.
mythos_cards.fail_condition:
If there are 6 Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. Each investigator must discard all of his money and any Retainer cards.

Activity At: Bank of Arkham

mythos_cards.title: Big Storm Sweeps Arkham!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Sky and Outskirts are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Bizarre Couriers
mythos_cards.text: Investigators in Arkham may immediately trade items or money without being in the same location. However, each investigator involved in the transaction loses 1 Sanity per item given or received.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: They come bearing strange messages, wrapped in ragged cloaks and hiding their pale flesh. Those who receive packages from them shudder at the memory of them, saying that they have the appearance of "plump, white grave worms."

mythos_cards.title: Bizarre Dreams Plague Citizens!
mythos_cards.text: All Gugs and Nightgaunts in Arkham are returned to the cup. If at least one monster returns to the cup, raise the terror level by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Black Sabbath!
mythos_cards.text: All Rat-things, Witches, and Warlocks in Arkham are returned to the cup. If at least one monster returns to the cup, raise the terror level by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Blackest Night
mythos_cards.text: Luck checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Sneak checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus.

mythos_cards.title: Blood Magic
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in Rivertown streets may choose to delve into dark mysteries using their life force. They roll dice equal to their current Stamina, and for every failed die, they lose 1 Stamina. If this reduces them to 0 Stamina, they are devoured and the player must start a new character. Otherwise, they gain 3 Clue tokens.

mythos_cards.title: Blue Flu!
mythos_cards.text: All investigators in jail are released. No investigators may be arrested until the end of next turn. Leave this card in play until then to indicate this.

mythos_cards.title: Blue Plate Special
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in Velma's Diner may spend up to $4 instead of having an Arkham encounter. They gain 1 Stamina and 1 Sanity for every $1 spent.

mythos_cards.title: Blue Skies
mythos_cards.text: All Investigators receive -1 Sneak, +1 Speed.

mythos_cards.title: Book Sale
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the Library may spend $2 instead of having an Arkham encounter. Any investigator that does so then takes the first Tome from the Unique Items deck.

mythos_cards.title: Brawling in the Streets
mythos_cards.text: Any investigator in a street area at the end of the Mythos phase must make a Fight (+0) check. If he fails and the terror level is 3 or less, he loses 1 Stamina. If he fails the check and the terror level is 4 or higher, he loses 2 Stamina.
mythos_cards.clue_location: Esoteric Order of Dagon or The Unnamable

mythos_cards.title: Break-In at Neil's
mythos_cards.text: The thieves carelessly break a dangerous artifact, releasing 2 monsters into the South Shore streets.

mythos_cards.title: Brutal Accident!
mythos_cards.text: The first player must choose one investigator (even himself). That investigator loses 3 Stamina.

mythos_cards.title: Campus Security Increased!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Miskatonic U. Streets or Locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Cash on the Hoof!
mythos_cards.text: The first player finds $2 lying on the ground.

mythos_cards.title: Charity Auction!
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: Deal a number of cards from the top of the Common Item deck equal to the number of players. Each player may purchase one item at its listed cost plus $1. Discard any items not purchased.

mythos_cards.title: Charity Case!
mythos_cards.text: The investigator with the lowest Sanity (the first player breaks ties) may move to Arkham Asylum and be delayed to restore his Sanity to its maximum.

mythos_cards.title: Checkered Cab Trials Begin!
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: All investigators in Arkham may move directly to any street location in Arkham as their entire move (ignore all monsters between their current location and their destination).
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Arkham experiments with mass transit.

mythos_cards.title: Church Boycotts Exhibit
mythos_cards.text: Lore checks in Arkham are made at a -2 penalty. Will checks in Arkham are made at a +2 bonus.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Father Michael organizes his congregation against the "Legacy of the Pharaohs" museum exhibit, calling the displays "ghastly and an affront against the Lord."

mythos_cards.title: Church Group Reclaims Southside!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Southside streets or locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Citizens Urged to Lock Doors
mythos_cards.text: Monsters appear in the Outskirts until the Outskirts limit is reached. If the Outskirts already contains the maximum number of monsters, return all of the monsters in the Outskirts to the monster cup and increase the terror level by 1.

mythos_cards.title: City Gripped by Blackouts!
mythos_cards.text: The General Store, Curiositie Shoppe, and Ye Olde Magick Shoppe are closed until the end of next turn. Leave this card in play until then to indicate this.

mythos_cards.title: Closed Mouths
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, Clue tokens do not appear on the board when mythos cards are resolved.

mythos_cards.title: Clothing Drive
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, investigators without Exhibit Items must evade or fight a Mummy in each street location they enter. These Mummies have the same stats as Zombies except with a toughness of 2, and cannot be taken as trophies.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Father Michael sends out a call for clothing. "Have you seen our streets? The homeless have been reduced to wearing rags and dirty strips!" In fact, the beings he has seen on the street are mummies, come to life and escaped from the visiting museum exhibit!

mythos_cards.title: Compass Needles Point South!
mythos_cards.text: The first player chooses two investigators. Those investigators immediately exchange locations, ignoring all monsters and movement restrictions.

mythos_cards.title: Construction Crew Conundrum!
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: A monster appears at the Downtown streets and the Miskatonic U. streets.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: While digging, a work crew uncovers ancient artifacts ... and ancient monsters.

mythos_cards.title: Contagion Kills Life in Blasted Heath!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Blasted Heath streets or locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Cops Sweep Kingsport!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in Kingsport street areas or locations are returned to the monster cup.

mythos_cards.title: Corpse Garden
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the Central Hill streets gain 2 Clue tokens, then lose 1 Sanity and 1 Stamina.

mythos_cards.title: Corpses Preserved
mythos_cards.text: Monster trophies come to life! Each investigator in Arkham must randomly choose one of his collected monster trophies. That monster surprises him. If the investigator defeats the monster, he may draw cards from the Exhibit Item deck equal to its toughness, take one, and discard the rest. Only monsters that are defeated may be taken as trophies again; if the investigator flees or the monster defeats him, the monster is returned to the box.

sections.Errata: The last line should say that the monster is returned to the cup, not to the box.

mythos_cards.title: Cosmic Upheaval!
mythos_cards.text: Investigators that are currently in Other Worlds must immediately pass a Luck (-1) check or be lost in time and space.

mythos_cards.title: Couriers in Town!
mythos_cards.text: Until the end of next turn, investigators may trade Items with one another without being in the same space. Leave this card in place to signify this. Items may only be traded in this manner during Upkeep.

mythos_cards.title: Cover-up
mythos_cards.text: When this card enters play, place 3 Clue tokens per player on it. Any player may discard monster trophies while in the Downtown streets during the Arkham Encounters Phase to remove 1 Clue token from this card for each toughness worth of monsters discarded.
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place 1 Clue token per player on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play).
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If there are no Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. Each investigator is Blessed, and gains a Retainer.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are 6 Clue tokens per player on this card, return it to the box. All investigators lose all of their Clue tokens, and all Clue tokens are removed from the board.

mythos_cards.title: Curfew Enforced
mythos_cards.text: Any investigator who ends his movement in the streets must pass a Will (+0) check or be arrested and taken to the Police Station.

sections.Clarification: Curfew Enforced does not apply to The Deputy of Arkham.

mythos_cards.title: Cursed Relics
mythos_cards.text: Place 5 doom tokens on this card when it comes into play.
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: At the end of every Mythos Phase after the first, move 1 doom token from this card to the terror track and increase the terror level by 1. Any player may exhaust a ready Exhibit Item or discard a Unique Item to negate both effects.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If there are no doom tokens on the terror track after the last doom token is removed from this card, discard this card. Each player draws 1 Spell.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are doom tokens on the terror track after the last doom token is removed from this card, discard this card and all doom tokens from the terror track. The terror level rises by a number equal to the number of doom tokens discarded.

mythos_cards.title: Dark Conjunction
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, all monsters gain Overwhelming 1. Any monster that already has Overwhelming has its Overwhelming rating increased by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Dark Day!
mythos_cards.text: Investigators cannot spend Clue tokens to add to skill checks until the end of next turn. Leave this card in play until then as a reminder.

mythos_cards.title: Dark Shapes at Dusk!
mythos_cards.text: All Ghasts, Leng Spiders, and Moon-beasts are returned to the cup. If at least one monster returns to the cup, raise the terror level by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Dark Skies
mythos_cards.text: Fight checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Sneak checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. Stalkers move like normal monsters.

mythos_cards.title: Darke's Carnival Arrives
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the Northside streets gain 1 Clue token from the sinister wonders they witness, but must pass a Will (-1) check or lose 1 Sanity.

mythos_cards.title: Deathly Still
mythos_cards.text: Will checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Fight checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. Monsters that move normally are stalkers.

mythos_cards.title: Dire Portents Abound
mythos_cards.text: Investigators receive -1 to checks to close Gates.

mythos_cards.title: Disturbing the Dead
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Roll a die at the end of every Mythos Phase while this card is in play (beginning the turn after it entered play). On a 1 or 2, increase the terror level by 1.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If a single player discards 2 gate trophies during the Arkham Encounter Phase while in the Rivertown streets, return this card to the box. Each player draws 1 Spell.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If the terror level reaches 10, return this card to the box. Every investigator is Cursed.

mythos_cards.title: Double the Trouble
mythos_cards.text: Two Gates open this turn, but no doom tokens are added to the doom track.

mythos_cards.title: Dreams of a Sunken City
mythos_cards.text: Investigators cannot gain Sanity except by receiving psychiatric care at Arkham Asylum (or from Carolyn Fern).

mythos_cards.title: Dunwich Villagers Drive Out Undesirables!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Village Commons streets or locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Early Frost
mythos_cards.text:
As they slip and fall on the ice, each investigator loses 1 Stamina for each movement point over 3 he spends each turn.
Reading Tomes does not count towards this total.

mythos_cards.title: Eccentric Opens Doors
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the French Hill streets may discard 1 Gate trophy to draw 1 Unique Item

mythos_cards.title: Eerie Coincidences
mythos_cards.text: Two Gates open this turn, but no doom tokens are added to the doom track.

mythos_cards.title: Egyptian Exhibit Visits Miskatonic U.
mythos_cards.text: Any investigator who ends his movement in the Miskatonic U. streets may pass a Lore (-1) check to gain 1 Clue token by reading the strange hieroglyphics on the artifacts in the exhibit.

mythos_cards.title: Endlessly Breeding
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: At the end of each Mythos phase, draw a second Mythos card and ignore everything on it except for its monster movement pattern. Each time an investigator is reduced to 0 Stamina or 0 Sanity, place a Clue token on this card.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If a single investigator discards $10 while at the Riverside Docks, return this card to the box. Starting with the first player, each player chooses a monster in play and takes it as a monster trophy (ignoring Endless).
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are ever 3 Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. A monster surge occurs, then add a doom token to the doom track for each Hex monster in play.

mythos_cards.title: Escape from Arkham Asylum!
mythos_cards.text:
Collect up to 3 Maniacs, drawing them first from the monster cup, then from the Outskirts, then from those claimed as trophies. Place them all in the Downtown streets.

Investigators who defeat all 3 Maniacs before the end of next turn may draw 1 Exhibit Item. Leave this card in play until then to indicate this.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The inmates at the Asylum all begin chanting in an ancient language, and overpower the orderlies! "Nephren-Ka! Nephren-Ka!" The streets flood with the insane.

mythos_cards.title: Estate Sale
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the Uptown streets may draw 2 Unique Items and purchase one, none, or both of them at list price, discarding any that are not purchased.

mythos_cards.title: Evidence Destroyed!
mythos_cards.text: A massive conspiracy sets back the investigation. Discard all Clue tokens from the board.

mythos_cards.title: Family Found Butchered!
mythos_cards.text: The terror level increases by 1 in light of this tragic news.

mythos_cards.title: Feds Raid Arkham!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the streets are returned to the cup.

sections.Clarification: This event does not apply to Spawn monsters.

mythos_cards.title: Fire at the Mill!
mythos_cards.text: Until the end of the next turn, any time an investigator draws 1 or more Common Items for any reason, he draws 1 fewer cards (to a minimum of 0). Leave this card in play to indicate this.
mythos_cards.clue_location:
* Congregational Hospital
* Cold Spring Glen or Black Cave

mythos_cards.title: Fires in the Night
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: Monsters at the Woods do not move. Monsters in the Uptown streets who move move to the woods.

mythos_cards.title: Footprints on Shore!
mythos_cards.text: It seems that 2 monsters have come ashore in the Innsmouth Shore streets.

mythos_cards.title: Forgery!
mythos_cards.text: Until the end of next turn, any time an investigator draws 1 or more Unique Items for any reason, he draws 1 fewer cards (to a minimum of 0). Leave this card in play to indicate this.
mythos_cards.clue_location:
* 607 Water St.
* Gardners' Place or Historical Society

mythos_cards.title: Formal Dress Gala Announced!
mythos_cards.text: Each investigator may choose to immediately spend $5 to gain 2 Sanity and 2 Clue tokens.
mythos_cards.clue_location: Esoteric Order of Dagon or Historical Society

mythos_cards.title: Fourth of July Parade!
mythos_cards.text: Investigators cannot move into or out of the Merchant Dist. streets until the end of next turn. Leave this card in play until then to indicate this.

mythos_cards.title: Free Clinic!
mythos_cards.text: The investigator with the lowest Stamina (the first player breaks ties) may move to St. Mary's Hospital and be delayed to restore his Stamina to its maximum.

mythos_cards.title: Full Moon
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: All monsters have their Sanity damage increased by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Fund Drive for the Arts
mythos_cards.text: Investigators in Arkham may immediately spend up to $1 for every Ally left in the Ally deck. For every $2 an investigator spends, he may draw one card from the Unique Item deck. He then takes one card from among those he has drawn and shuffles the rest back into the deck.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The performance of the controversial "The King in Yellow" have increased local enthusiasm for the arts, and the Historical Society is taking advantage of it with a fundraising auction.

mythos_cards.title: Funnel Clouds
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text:
Any investigator who ends his movement in the streets must pass a Luck (+1) check or be devoured.

All flying monsters are returned to the monster cup.

mythos_cards.title: Gangs Clean Up Easttown!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Easttown streets or locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Gathering Storm!
mythos_cards.text: The situation in Innsmouth continues to worsen. Add one uprising token to the Deep Ones Rising track.

mythos_cards.title: Ghost Ship Docks by Itself!
mythos_cards.text: An ancient ghost ship arrives in Arkham, releasing 2 monsters into the Merchant Dist. streets.

mythos_cards.title: Goat-like Creature Spotted in Woods!
mythos_cards.text: All Dark Young in Arkham are returned to the cup. If at least one monster returns to the cup, raise the terror level by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Good Traveling Conditions
mythos_cards.text: Fight checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Speed checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus, and investigators receive 1 extra movement point. Monsters that move normally are fast.

mythos_cards.title: Good Work Undone
mythos_cards.text: When this card enters play, place 6 Clue tokens on it. Any player may spend Clue tokens during the Arkham Encounter Phase while in the Easttown streets to discard Clue tokens from this card on a 1-for-1 basis.
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Roll two dice at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play). For every 1 or 2 rolled, place one Clue token on this card.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If there are no Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. Each player draws one unique item.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are 10 Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. All elder sign tokens are removed from the board.

mythos_cards.title: Gossip Runs Wild!
mythos_cards.text: If the Dunwich Horror is in play, increase the terror level by 2. Investigators can trade Clue tokens like other Items until the end of next turn. Leave this card in play until then to show this.

mythos_cards.title: Graverobbers Strike!
mythos_cards.text: Unfortunately for them, they release 2 monsters into the Central Hill streets.

mythos_cards.title: Gypsy Caravan
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the Southside Streets may roll a die. On a success, they gain $2. On a failure, they lose $1.

mythos_cards.title: Hallelujah!
mythos_cards.text: The first investigator who ends his movement in South Church is Blessed, then discards this card from play.

mythos_cards.title: Happy Days are Here Again
mythos_cards.text: Due to the renewed prosperity that has come to Arkham, the terror level cannot increase.

mythos_cards.title: Heat Wave
mythos_cards.text: Fight checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Lore checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. Fire Vampires have their toughness increased by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Hellene Sighted!
mythos_cards.text: The ancient ship briefly docks, releasing 2 monsters into the Harborside streets.

mythos_cards.title: Help Wanted
mythos_cards.text: The first investigator without a Retainer who ends his movement at the Newspaper gains a Retainer, then discards this card from play.

mythos_cards.title: High Tides
mythos_cards.text: Investigators in Rivertown, Easttown, and Merchant District streets or locations must pass a Fight (-1) Check or be delayed.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The tides seem to be defying the tidal charts, causing elevated water levels far upriver.

mythos_cards.title: Horns of the Black Goat
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: Dark Young have their toughness increased by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Horrifying Sight!
mythos_cards.text: The first player must choose one investigator (even himself). That investigator loses 3 Sanity.

mythos_cards.title: Horror at Groundbreaking!
mythos_cards.text: An ancient stone is disturbed by the construction, releasing 2 monsters into the Miskatonic U. streets.

mythos_cards.title: Hospital Patients Disappear!
mythos_cards.text: All investigators who have an Injury card (from the Dunwich Horror expansion) or whose Stamina is currently 2 or less move immediately to the first area of Another Dimension.

mythos_cards.title: Icy Conditions
mythos_cards.text: Investigators receive 1 less movement point during the Movement Phase. Fast Monsters move like normal monsters.

mythos_cards.title: Ill Wind Grips Arkham!
mythos_cards.text: The first player must pass a Luck (-1) check or be Cursed

sections.Clarification: Despite the name of the card, the first player must pass the check even if he currently is in an other world.

mythos_cards.title: Impassable Streets
mythos_cards.text: An investigator may not move to a street area if there is a black movement arrow leading to it from his present street area. This does not effect moving from a location to a street area or from a street area to a location.

mythos_cards.title: Infestation of Rats
mythos_cards.text: Each investigator in Ma's Boarding House or Velma's Diner at the end of the Mythos Phase, as well as each investigator in First National Grocery, Gilman House Hotel, or Innsmouth Jail on the Innsmouth Horror expansion game board at the end of the Mythos Phase, loses 1 Sanity.

mythos_cards.title: Innsmouth Invasion!
mythos_cards.text: The city of Innsmouth is suddenly crawling with monsters. A monster appears in the Church Green streets, the Innsmouth Shore streets, the Factory District streets, Sawbone Alley, and Devil Reef.

mythos_cards.title: Innsmouth is Restless
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, investigators who end their movement in Innsmouth receive a -1 penalty to their Evade check to avoid being arrested once martial law is declared in Innsmouth.

mythos_cards.title: Innsmouth Sleeps
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, investigators who end their movement in Innsmouth do not need to make the usual Evade check to avoid being arrested once martial law is declared in Innsmouth.

mythos_cards.title: Intermission
mythos_cards.text:
The town of Arkham collectively holds its breath as the terrible play "The King in Yellow" builds to a crescendo, preparing to reveal its darkest horrors.
But for the moment, nothing happens. No gates open, but the terror level is increased by 2.

mythos_cards.title: Jail Break!
mythos_cards.text: However, it appears that whatever was being held in the jail wasn't quite human, so 2 monsters are released into the Church Green streets.

mythos_cards.title: King of Cards Cancels Show
mythos_cards.text: All Witches and Warlocks in Arkham are returned to the cup. If any investigator has Eric Weiss as an Ally, that investigator gains those monsters as trophies.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Erich Weiss, a famous visiting escape artist and master of illusion, was scheduled to put on a show. However, when he was told that the "Legacy of the Pharaohs" museum exhibit was in town, he paled visibly and canceled the performance. "There is a thing I must do" was his only comment.

mythos_cards.title: Kingsport Mists
mythos_cards.text: Sneak checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. The Causeway, the Wireless Station, and the Strange High House in the Mists are closed while this card remains in play.

mythos_cards.title: Lightning Storm
mythos_cards.text: At the start of each Upkeep Phase while this card is in play, roll a die. On a 1 or 2, the first player must choose an investigator in a street area (if there are any). That investigator loses a die of Stamina and moves to St. Mary's Hospital.

mythos_cards.title: Lightning Strikes Twice!
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: Two similar rocks are shattered by lightning strikes in different parts of Arkham, each releasing a monster. A monster appears at the French Hill streets and the Uptown streets.

mythos_cards.title: Local Heiress Missing!
mythos_cards.text: If any player has Asenath Waite as an Ally, she is returned to the box and a doom token is added to the Ancient One's doom track.

mythos_cards.title: Lodge Member Held for Questioning!
mythos_cards.text: A Silver Lodge ritual lets 2 monsters loose in the French Hill streets.

mythos_cards.title: Lodge Members Watch the Night!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the French Hill streets or locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Lynch Mob!
mythos_cards.text: One Ally is randomly drawn from the Ally deck and returned to the box.

mythos_cards.title: Mad Bomber
mythos_cards.text: When this card enters play, place $4 per player on it. Any player may pay money while in the Merchant District streets during the Arkham Encounters Phase to remove money from this card on a 1-for-1 basis.
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place $1 per player on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play).
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If there is no money on this card, return it to the box. Each player gains 2 Clue tokens.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there is $8 per player on this card, return it to the box. Every Investigator must immediately draw 1 Injury and 1 Madness card.

mythos_cards.title: Manhunt in Arkham!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Medical Supplies Contaminated
mythos_cards.text: When an investigator pays $2 to use the "Medical Care" ability at St. Mary's Hospital, he loses 1 Sanity. When an investigator pays $2 to use the "Psychiatric Care" ability at Arkham Asylum, he loses 1 Stamina.
mythos_cards.clue_location: Cold Spring Glen or Unvisited Isle

mythos_cards.title: Merchants March on Crime!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Merchant Dist. streets or locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Meteorite Spotted in Blasted Heath!
mythos_cards.text: A crashed meteorite releases 2 monsters into the Blasted Heath streets.

mythos_cards.title: Mirages of Lakes
mythos_cards.text: When investigators move from one street to another, they may only move in the direction of the black arrows. Locations may be entered normally.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: It's called the "Hali Effect." It is similar to seeing mirages in the desert, but it only occurs in urban environments. Entire cities claim to see vast lakes bordering their neighborhoods, where just the day before was dry land. Sometimes the mirage recedes as the viewer walks forward... sometimes it does not.

mythos_cards.title: Miskatonic Arctic Expedition Returns!
mythos_cards.text: Any Elder Things previously claimed as monster trophies by players return to life and are placed in the River Docks.

sections.Mythos Source: The Miskatonic Arctic Expedition is the subject of H. P. Lovecraft's classic novella 'At the Mountains of Madness' (1936) in which the Elder Things first appear.

mythos_cards.title: Miskatonic Launches New Research Ship!
mythos_cards.text: Place 2 Clue tokens in the River Docks, Unvisited Isle, as well as all aquatic locations and all aquatic street areas on expansion game boards.

mythos_cards.title: Miskatonic Scientists Research Anomalies!
mythos_cards.text: Place 2 Clue tokens in the Science Building as well as all street areas and locations adjacent to a vortex.

mythos_cards.title: Missing People Return!
mythos_cards.text: All investigators currently lost in time and space immediately return to Arkham, appearing in a street or location of their choice.

mythos_cards.title: Mistrust
mythos_cards.text: When this card enters play, place 3 Clue tokens per player on it. Any player may discard Common or Unique Items while in the Southside streets during the Arkham Encounters Phase to remove 1 Clue token per Common or 2 per Unique Item discarded.
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place 1 Clue token per player on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play).
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If there are no Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. Each investigator gains an Ally.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are 6 Clue tokens per player on this card, return it to the box. Investigators may no longer trade items and all investigators have their Focus reduced to 0 for the rest of the game.

mythos_cards.title: Moon Creature Hoax
mythos_cards.text: The first player draws a monster marker from the cup at random and places it in the Sky. Treat this monster as a flying monster until it moves to a street area. After that, the monster's movement is treated normally.

mythos_cards.title: Mudslides
mythos_cards.text: During the Mythos Phase, each player whose investigator is in a street area must roll a die. If the result is a 1, the investigator must move to the street area that is reached by following the white arrow from his current street area. If the white arrow leads to a vortex or an area with a gate, the investigator stays in his current street area instead.
mythos_cards.clue_location:
* 7th House on the Left
* Devil's Hopyard or The Witch House

mythos_cards.title: Murder in the Museum
mythos_cards.text: Players in Arkham with gate trophies must make a Fight check or Lore check for each trophy they have, with a modifier equal to the modifier printed on the gate. If a check for a gate is failed, draw monsters from the cup until you draw a monster with a symbol that matches the one on the gate, and place that monster in the player's current location. If the check for a gate succeeds, the player may remove one monster with that gate's symbol from Arkham, the Outskirts, or the Sky.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The victims of a ritual murder are found at the "Legacy of the Pharaohs" museum exhibit. The professors brought in from Miskatonic believe that it was an opening ritual.

mythos_cards.title: Murderer at Large; Victims' Brains Missing
mythos_cards.text: The terror level increases by 1.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Victims of a string of murders are left as desiccated corpses with their brains and internal organs removed.

mythos_cards.title: Museum Artifacts Stolen
mythos_cards.text: Investigators in Arkham may pay $5 in bribe fees to make a connection with the robbers. Those who do so may draw a number of Exhibit Items equal to their focus, choose one, and discard the rest.

mythos_cards.title: Museum Haunted
mythos_cards.text: The ghosts of the pharaohs walk abroad! Collect up to 2 Ghosts, drawing them first from the monster cup, then from the Outskirts, then from those claimed as trophies. Place them in the Miskatonic U. streets. Investigators who destroy one of these Ghosts before the end of next turn may draw one Exhibit Item. Leave this card in play until then to indicate this. The terror level increases by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Mysterious Crates Found Empty!
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: But the monsters inside them have already escaped. A monster appears at the Riverside streets and the Northside streets.

mythos_cards.title: Mysterious Lights Fade!
mythos_cards.text: The investigators may collectively spend 5 Clue tokens. If they do so, the first player may choose and close 1 open Gate in any Arkham location and reshuffle it into the stack of Gate markers (he does not gain a Gate trophy). The investigators may not do this if there is only 1 open Gate.

mythos_cards.title: Neighborhood Sale
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the Easttown streets may draw 2 Common Items and purchase one, none, or both of them at list price, discarding any that are not purchased.

mythos_cards.title: New Miskatonic U. Curriculum
mythos_cards.text: If an investigator reads a Tome in the Library, he gains a +2 bonus to any Lore check made to do so.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: "The King in Yellow" has, amidst heavy controversy, been added to the library curriculum at the University. Its teaching has stirred up the students' interest in all written occult works.

mythos_cards.title: New Moon
mythos_cards.text: Investigators receive 1 less movement point (to a minimum of 0) during the Movement Phase. When an investigator is driven insane, he does not discard any of his Clue tokens.

mythos_cards.title: Nightmare Pool
mythos_cards.text: When this card enters play, place 3 Sanity tokens per player on it. Any player may pay Sanity while in the Uptown streets during the Arkham Encounters Phase to remove Sanity tokens from this card on a one-for-one basis.
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place 1 Sanity token per player on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play).
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If there are no Sanity tokens on this card, return it to the box. Each player draws 1 Common Item.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are 6 Sanity tokens per player on this card, return it to the box. Immeditately draw and resolve 3 more mythos cards, one after the other.

mythos_cards.title: No One Can Help You Now
mythos_cards.text: Gates cannot be sealed, although they can still be closed.

mythos_cards.title: Noden's Favor
mythos_cards.text: It costs 2 fewer Clue tokens to seal gates.

mythos_cards.title: Noted Author Dies
mythos_cards.text: All players must discard 1 Clue token.

mythos_cards.title: Off Broadway
mythos_cards.text: All purchases in Arkham cost $1 more than usual.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The performances of the new play "The King in Yellow" are garnering rave reviews. Theater professors at Miskatonic University claim never to have heard of it, but nonetheless, the wealthy and influential from all around New England are flocking to see it. The shops have, of course, raised their prices to take advantage of this influx of money.

mythos_cards.title: Old Building Collapses!
mythos_cards.text: Unfortunately, the building was containing 2 monsters, which have now been released into the Factory District streets.

mythos_cards.title: Old Debts Come Due!
mythos_cards.text: Raise the terror level by 1. Any investigator who has previously made a deal with the Dark Man of Wizard's Hill is devoured. For every investigator devoured in this way, place 3 doom tokens on the doom track. All current debts to the Dark Man are now considered paid.

mythos_cards.title: One Thousand Young
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: When a monster enters Uptown Streets, place it on this card. Monsters on this card do not count against the monster limit.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: Investigators who end their movement in the Uptown Streets may make a Lore (-1) check to place a clue token on this card. If there are as many clue tokens on this card as there are investigators plus one, return it to the box (and all monsters on it to the cup) and each investigator gains a random monster trophy.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are as many monsters on this card as there are investigators plus one, return it to the box (and all monsters on it to the cup). All investigators are devoured.

mythos_cards.title: Oppressive Atmosphere
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, all monsters gain Nightmarish 1. Any monster that already has Nightmarish has its Nightmarish rating increased by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Order of Dagon Suspected!
mythos_cards.text: Although no proof exists, it is suspected that the Esoteric Order of Dagon released 2 monsters into the Church Green streets.

mythos_cards.title: Parazoologist Visits Miskatonic U.
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the Miskatonic U. Streets may discard 5 Toughness worth of monster trophies to gain 1 Spell.

mythos_cards.title: Patient Claims Madness Caused by Words!
mythos_cards.text: Each investigator with a Tome loses 2 Sanity. Each investigator who does not have a Tome, but does have 1 or more Spells, loses 1 Sanity.
mythos_cards.clue_location:
* The Hall School
* Y'ha-nthlei or The Unnamable

mythos_cards.title: Pets and Wildlife Mutilated!
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: Monsters must be on the prowl. A monster appears in the Merchant District streets and the Southside streets.

mythos_cards.title: Pickpocket Ring at Large!
mythos_cards.text: Each investigator must make a Luck (-1) check. Any investigator that fails must either discard his most expensive item or lose all of his money.

mythos_cards.title: Picnickers Panic!
mythos_cards.text: A careless picnicker unleashes 2 monsters on the Downtown streets.

mythos_cards.title: Plague of Frogs
mythos_cards.text: Lore checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Will checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. Witches and Warlocks move like stalkers.

mythos_cards.title: Plague of Insects
mythos_cards.text: Investigators that end their turns in the street lose 1 Stamina and 1 Sanity. The terror level increases by 1.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The strange locusts and beetles around town have reached a critical mass! They crawl, fly and hop everywhere.

mythos_cards.title: Planetary Alignment
mythos_cards.text: Thanks to the mystic energy generated by the planetary alignment, all Spells have a Sanity cost of 0.

mythos_cards.title: Plans in Motion
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: At the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after this card enters play), roll a die. On a 1 or 2, add one uprising token to the Deep Ones Rising track.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If the Feds Raid Innsmouth track is filled, resolve it, then return this card to the box.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If the Ancient One awakens, return this card to the box.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Strange schemes are afoot in the city of Innsmouth, preparing the way for the Ancient One's awakening.

mythos_cards.title: Police Helpless to Displace Vagrants
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the Downtown streets may spend $5 or 2 Clue tokens to draw the top 3 cards of the Spell deck, choose 1 Spell to keep, and discard the rest.

mythos_cards.title: Police Offer Reward for Information!
mythos_cards.text: Each investigator may spend any number of his Clue tokens. For each Clue token he spends, he gains $2.

mythos_cards.title: Police Proclaim Cult Crackdown
mythos_cards.text: All Cultists in Arkham are returned to the cup.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The police say that the recent rise in cultist activity cannot be tolerated, and call on all citizens to report sightings of "people in strange garb or performing rituals."

mythos_cards.title: Police Step Up Patrols in Northside!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Northside streets or locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Private Security Hired in Uptown!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Uptown streets or locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Profane Relics Seized
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place 1 Clue token on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play).
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If an investigator with either a Silver Twilight Lodge Membership or a "One of the Thousand" Cult Membership (from the The Black Goat of the Woods expansion) discards 3 Clue tokens while at the South Church, return this card to the box. Each investigator then gains 1 Unique Item.
mythos_cards.fail_condition:
If there are 6 Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box, draw 2 Unique Items per investigator and return them to the box.

Activity At: South Church

mythos_cards.title: Raining Cats and Dogs
mythos_cards.text: Speed checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty, and players receive one less movement point during the Movement Phase. Sneak checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. Return any Fire Vampires in play to the cup. If a Fire Vampire enters play, return it to the cup and draw a different monster.

mythos_cards.title: Rare Antiquities Up for Auction!
mythos_cards.text: The first player draws 1 Unique Item. He may purchase it for the list price. Each time a player chooses not to purchase it, the player to his left may purchase it, but the price goes up by $1. Once each player has had a chance to buy the item, if no one has purchased it, the item is discarded.

mythos_cards.title: Rash of Graffiti
mythos_cards.text: Skill checks to close or seal gates in Arkham are made at a -2 penalty.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Business and homeowners alike have reported an increase in graffiti around Arkham. The perpetrators seem to have a penchant for yellow paint. They believe that some ne'er-do-wells have come into a few cases of the stuff and are just having trouble figuring out what to do with it. But could it be something more sinister?

mythos_cards.title: Rash of Missing Persons!
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: The first player chooses an investigator to be lost in time and space

mythos_cards.title: Relentless Doom
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, monster surges cause 1 doom token to be added to the Ancient One's doom track.

mythos_cards.title: Restful Day!
mythos_cards.text: All investigators gain 1 Stamina.

mythos_cards.title: Return to the Old Ways
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place 1 Clue token on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase after the first. Any time a player attempts to use a Common Item, whether by applying its bonuses to combat, exhausting it, or discarding it, roll a die. On a 1 or 2, it falls apart before it can be used and must be discarded.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If a player discards a Common Item while in an Other World, return this card to the box. Each player gains 2 Clue tokens.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are 5 Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. All Common Items in play are discarded, and the Common Item deck is removed from the game.

mythos_cards.title: Ring Around the Moon
mythos_cards.text: Each time an investigator in Arkham fails a Spell check, add a doom token to the doom track.

mythos_cards.title: Riots
mythos_cards.text: When this card enters play, place 3 Stamina tokens per player on it. Any player may pay Stamina while in the Northside streets during the Arkham Encounters Phase to remove Stamina tokens from this card on a 1-for-1 basis.
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place 1 Stamina token per player on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play).
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If there are no Stamina tokens on this card, return it to the box. Each player draws 1 Spell.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are 6 Stamina tokens per player on this card, return it to the box. From now on, it costs investigators 2 movement points to enter a street area instead of 1.

mythos_cards.title: Rituals of Power
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: An arcane ritual increases the Stamina damage of all monsters by 1.

mythos_cards.title: River Breaches the Levees
mythos_cards.text:
Place 1 Exhibit Item, facedown, in each of the Merchant District and Rivertown streets. The first investigator to reach one of these neighborhood streets may end his turn to take the item.

The terror level increases by 1.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The river floods suddenly, drowning the streets of Arkham. When it recedes, it leaves behind strange artifacts that look like they came down the Nile!

sections.Clarification: Once one of the Exhibit Items is taken, the other is discarded.

mythos_cards.title: Rivertown Residents Take Back Streets!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Rivertown streets or locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: R'lyeh Rising
mythos_cards.text: Star Spawn and Maniacs have their toughness increased by 1. The difficulty to seal or close gates to R'lyeh is increased by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Sailor Take Warning
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, any investigator who enters an aquatic location must pass a Fight (-1) check or lose 2 Stamina.

mythos_cards.title: Scholar Speaks of Leylines
mythos_cards.text: Spells cost 1 additional Sanity to cast, but any investigator who successfully casts a Spell receives +1 Fight and +1 Will until the end of his turn.

mythos_cards.title: School of Medicine Seeks Test Subjects!
mythos_cards.text: Each investigator may choose to lose 2 Stamina to gain a Retainer.
mythos_cards.clue_location:
* Neil's Curiosity Shop
* Gardners' Place or Science Building

mythos_cards.title: Scientist Warns of Dimensional Rift!
mythos_cards.text: All Dimensional Shamblers and Hounds of Tindalos are returned to the cup. If one or more monster is returned to the cup, raise the terror level by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Scurrilous Stranger Scandal!
mythos_cards.text: The investigators may collectively spend 5 Clue tokens. If they do so, the first player draws a Gate marker and claims it as a trophy.

mythos_cards.title: Seven for a Secret, Never to be Told
mythos_cards.text: During the Upkeep Phase, the first player rolls 2 dice. If the sum of the result is 7, each investigator wih no Clue tokens gains 1 Clue token and loses 1 Sanity.

mythos_cards.title: Severe Hailstorm
mythos_cards.text: Any investigator in a street area at the end of the Mythos Phase must choose 1 item to discard.
mythos_cards.clue_location: Esoteric Order of Dagon or The Unnamable

mythos_cards.title: Sheldon Gang Turns to Police for Aid!
mythos_cards.text: The Sheldon Gang disturbs a burial mound, releasing 2 monsters into the Uptown Streets.

mythos_cards.title: Shipwreck!
mythos_cards.text: The boat's hold releases 2 monsters into the Innsmouth Shore streets.

mythos_cards.title: Signs of Cult Activity!
mythos_cards.text: The cultists performed a ritual that released 2 monsters into the Factory District streets.

mythos_cards.title: Silver Twilight Lodge on Trial!
mythos_cards.text: Anyone with a Silver Twilight Lodge Membership is arrested. All other investigators who have 1 or more Spells must discard a Spell or be arrested.
mythos_cards.clue_location:
* St. Erasmus's Home
* Esoteric Order of Dagon or Black Cave

mythos_cards.title: Slugs
mythos_cards.text: Fight and Speed checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Arkham has been hit by a plague of these slimy creatures, all oozing about with some unknown purpose.

mythos_cards.title: Slum Murders Continue!
mythos_cards.text: An old basement is opened, releasing 2 monsters into the Easttown Streets

mythos_cards.title: Snow Drifts
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who move into a street area must end their movement. They must still evade or combat any monsters in that area, however. Note that this only applies to street areas that an investigator moves into, not a street area in which he starts his Movement Phase.
mythos_cards.clue_location: Esoteric Order of Dagon or Historical Society

mythos_cards.title: Solar Eclipse
mythos_cards.text: Due to the interference of the solar eclipse, no spells may be cast

mythos_cards.title: Someone's Watching Me
mythos_cards.text: The first investigator to close or seal a gate is Blessed. Discard this card afterwards.

mythos_cards.title: Songs from the Woods
mythos_cards.text: Goat Spawn, Tcho-tchos, and Dark Young have their toughness increased by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Soothing Night!
mythos_cards.text: All investigators gain 1 Sanity.

mythos_cards.title: Soup Kitchen Seeks Donations!
mythos_cards.text: If a single investigator spends $3, every other investigator with no money gains 1 Stamina.

mythos_cards.title: Southside Strangler Suspected!
mythos_cards.text: However, the press is mistaken, and the murders were caused by 2 monsters that are released into the Southside streets.

mythos_cards.title: Spawn of Yog-Sothoth
mythos_cards.text: Cultists have Magical Immunity. Additionally, any investigator who is lost in time and space must pass a Will (-1) check or be devoured.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: A strange group of protestors surrounds the playhouse where "The King in Yellow" is being performed, chanting "He is the spawn of Yog-Sothoth!" and waving placards that read "Have You Seen the Yellow Sign?"

mythos_cards.title: Spiritualism Gains in Popularity
mythos_cards.text: Investigators may not evade Undead monsters and receive -1 on Combat checks against Undead monsters.
mythos_cards.clue_location: Esoteric Order of Dagon or Black Cave

mythos_cards.title: Stalkers in the Night!
mythos_cards.text: All Star Vampires, Hunting Horrors, and Spectral Hunters in Arkham are returned to the cup. If at least one monster returns to the cup, raise the terror level by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Startling Message Sent from Overseas!
mythos_cards.text: Place 2 Clue tokens on the Newspaper. If the Kingsport Horror expansion game board is in play, place an additional 2 Clue tokens on the Wireless Station.

mythos_cards.title: Stopped Clocks
mythos_cards.text: During each phase of the game turn, players may choose the player order during that phase. (Note that the order of the phases remains unchanged.) If players cannot agree on an order, the first player chooses. At the end of the turn, the first player marker is passed to the left as usual.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Creatures Seen on the Shore!
mythos_cards.text: A monster appears in each of the following: River Docks, Unvisited Isle, and all aquatic locations and all aquatic street areas on expansion game boards.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Forces Exorcised from Arkham!
mythos_cards.text: Until the end of next turn, any time an investigator draws 1 or more Spells for any reason, he draws 1 fewer card (to a minimum of 0). Leave this card in play to indicate this.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Lights on Campus!
mythos_cards.text: The Library, Administration Building and Science Building are all closed until the end of next turn. Leave this card in play until then to indicate this.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Murders
mythos_cards.text: Flying monsters have their toughness increased by 2 and gain Overwhelming 1.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Their heads have holes bored into the top. Their skulls are empty. And that is the only thing the murder victims have in common.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Ornithological Sightings
mythos_cards.text: Draw monsters from the monster cup until you have drawn 2 flying monsters. They are placed in the Sky. Flying monsters do not attack investigators with Exhibit Items before the end of next turn. Leave this care in play until then to indicate this.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Power Flux Plagues City!
mythos_cards.text: All investigators in Other World areas may immediately return to Arkham.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Sightings!
mythos_cards.text:
A monster surge occurs. However, no gates open this turn.
The first player gains 1 Clue token.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Sightings! (2)
mythos_cards.text: A monster surge occurs. However, no gates open this turn. The first player gains 1 Clue token.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Sightings! (3)
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: A monster surge occurs. However, no gates open this turn. The first player gains 1 Clue token.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Sightings! (4) x2
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: A monster surge occurs. However, no gates open this turn. The first player gains 1 Clue token.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Sightings! (5)
mythos_cards.text:
A monster surge occurs. However, no gates open this turn.
The first player gains 1 Clue token.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Sightings! (6) x2
mythos_cards.text: A monster surge occurs. However, no gates open this turn. The first player gains 1 Clue token.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Sightings! (7) x2
mythos_cards.text: A monster surge occurs. However, no gates open this turn. The first player gains 1 Clue token.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Sleep Disorder Baffles Doctors!
mythos_cards.text: All investigators who have a Madness card (from the Dunwich Horror expansion) or whose Sanity is currently 2 or less must move immediately to the first area of the Dreamlands.
mythos_cards.clue_location:
* The Rope and Anchor
* Devil Reef or Historical Society

mythos_cards.title: Strange Statue Destroyed!
mythos_cards.text: Unfortunately, the statue's destruction lets 2 monsters loose in the Village Commons streets.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Surprise!
mythos_cards.text: A monster appears at the first player's location. If this is a stable location or an Other World area, the monster appears in the Outskirts instead.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Tremors Cease!
mythos_cards.text: All Chthonians and Dholes in Arkham are returned to the cup. If at least one monster returns to the cup, raise the terror level by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Visions Cease!
mythos_cards.text: The first player chooses one rift token on the rift track. If that rift is active, turn the token facedown. Otherwise, return it to the bank.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Waves Subside!
mythos_cards.text: The first player chooses one open gate and closes it, returning its gate token to the gate token pile.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Whispers Promise Vengeance!
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: A monster appears at a street location chosen by the first player.

mythos_cards.title: Strange Woman Distributing Words
mythos_cards.text: The first player draws a Spell.

mythos_cards.title: Strength of the Earth
mythos_cards.text: All monsters with a moon dimensional symbol have their toughness, combat damage (if any), and horror damage (if any) increased by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Students Protest Museum Exhibit
mythos_cards.text: Any investigator who ends his movement in the streets must make a Fight (-1) check or be delayed by the throngs of protestors.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The students of Miskatonic are stirred up by the "disrespectful scavenging of a society's remains" - by which they mean the visiting museum exhibit.

mythos_cards.title: Sunny and Clear
mythos_cards.text:
Sneak checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty.

Will checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus.

If the Hunter in Darkness is in play, return it to the cup. If the Hunter in Darkness enters play, return it to the cup and draw a different monster.

sections.Errata: While this card refers to a Hunter in Darkness monster, no such monster appears to exist, either in the original Arkham Horror or in the expansions. The text should probably be taken to refer to the Haunter of the Dark, a Mask monster.

mythos_cards.title: Superstitions Abound!
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: The first player chooses one investigator to become Blessed and another investigator to become Cursed. (If there is only one investigator, nothing happens).

mythos_cards.title: Surrounded by Mystery
mythos_cards.text: Two Gates open this turn, but no doom tokens are added to the doom track.

mythos_cards.title: Taxes Come Due!
mythos_cards.text: All investigators discard one half of all their money (rounded down).
mythos_cards.clue_location:
* North Point Lighthouse
* Esoteric Order of Dagon or Science Building

mythos_cards.title: Temperence Fever Sweeps City
mythos_cards.text: Any investigator with Whiskey must pass a Sneak (-1) check or get arrested and taken to the Police Station. If this occurs, they must discard their Whiskey. In addition, Hibb's Roadhouse is closed until the end of next turn. Leave this card in play until then to indicate this.

sections.Clarification: This event does not affect investigators in the Other Worlds.

mythos_cards.title: Terror at the Train Station!
mythos_cards.text: A rusty train arrives in Arkham, disgorging 2 monsters into the Northside streets.

mythos_cards.title: The Ancient One's Servants!
mythos_cards.text: If there are any Deep Ones or Cultists in play, add 1 doom token to the Ancient One's doom track.

mythos_cards.title: The Chill of the Grave
mythos_cards.text: All Undead monsters have their toughness increased by 1

mythos_cards.title: The Doors of Sleep
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the Harborside streets gain 1 Clue token, then have an encounter during the Other Worlds Encounters Phase as though they were in the Dreamlands.

mythos_cards.title: The Evil is Everywhere
mythos_cards.text: Two Gates open this turn, but no doom tokens are added to the doom track.

mythos_cards.title: The Festival
mythos_cards.text: Cultists and Byakhees have their toughness increased by 1.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The festival has begun!

mythos_cards.title: The Great Ritual
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Cultists, Witches, Warlocks, and High Priests have their toughness increased by 2 while this card is in play. Place 1 clue token on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play).
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If a single player discards 3 spells (4 if there are 5 or more players) while in the French Hill streets during the Arkham Encounters phase, return this card to the box. Each player gains 2 clue tokens.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are ever 5 Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. From now on, draw 2 Mythos cards each Mythos Phase. Ignore everything on the first card except for the gate opening.

mythos_cards.title: The Innsmouth Plague
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: At the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after this card enters play), the first player draws one Innsmouth Look card.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If an investigator discards 2 Spells during the Arkham Encounters Phase while in the Church Green streets, return this card to the box.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If an investigator gets the Innsmouth Look and is devoured, return this card to the box.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: A terrible plague begins to spread from the city of Innsmouth.
