mythos_cards.title: The Key and the Gate
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Each time a Gate opens, place a Clue token on this card.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: Investigators who end their movement in the Southside streets can discard two Gate trophies to return this card to the box and gain 2 Clue tokens.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: When there are as many Clue tokens on this card as there are investigators plus one, return this card to the box and draw a new Mythos card. Treat any Gates opened by that Mythos card as Gate bursts and ignore the rest of the card.

mythos_cards.title: The Man in Black
mythos_cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the French Hill streets may deal with the Man in Black to gain power. They roll dice equal to their current Sanity and for every failed die, the lose 1 Sanity. If this reduces them to 0 Sanity, they are devoured and the player must start a new character. Otherwise, they gain 1 Clue token and draw 1 Spell.

mythos_cards.title: The Next Act Begins! x3
mythos_cards.text:
The terror level is increased by 1. However, no gate is opened this turn.

The next act of the charity performance of The King in Yellow has begun.

The first player must put the top card of the Act deck into play.

The first player gains 1 Clue token.

mythos_cards.title: The Next Act Begins! (2) x3
mythos_cards.text:
The terror level is increased by 1. However, no gate is opened this turn.

The next act of the charity performance of The King in Yellow has begun.

The first player must put the top card of the Act deck into play.

The first player gains 1 Clue token.

mythos_cards.title: The Rails are Washed Out
mythos_cards.text: Investigators cannot travel between cities using the Train Station or other depot locations while this card remains in play.

mythos_cards.title: The Repairer of Reputations
mythos_cards.text: Players who are Cursed, have an outstanding bank loan, possess a Detriment card, or are in jail may immediately discard the offending cards and/or may be immediately freed from jail. Those who take advantage of this offer are reduced to 0 Sanity.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: Signs are place in conspicuous locations, advertising "Mr. Wilde, Repairer of Reputations."

sections.Mythos Source: The Repairer of Reputations is a short story featured in the anthology The King in Yellow, written by Robert W. Chambers (1895).

mythos_cards.title: The Siren Call!
mythos_cards.text: A strange feeling pulls the first player towards the sea, forcing him to draw two Innsmouth Look cards.

mythos_cards.title: The Southside Strangler Strikes
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Return one Ally from the Ally deck to the box at random at the end of every Mythos Phase while this card is in play (beginning the turn after it entered play). The Southside Strangler has struck again!
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If a single player discards 5 Clue tokens while in Ma's Boarding House during the Arkham Encounters Phase, return this card to the box. Each player receives a $5 reward from the police.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are no more Allies to return to the box at the end of the Mythos Phase, return this card to the box. Each player must lower either their maximum Sanity or Stamina (their choice) by 1 for the rest of the game.

sections.Misprint: The Pass condition should be resolved in the Southside Streets instead of Ma's Boarding House.

mythos_cards.title: The Stars Are Right
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Roll a die at the end of every Mythos Phase while this card is in play (beginning the turn after it enters play). On a 1 or 2, place one doom token on the ancient one's doom track.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If a player discards an Ally card while in the Downtown streets during the Arkham Encounter Phase, return this card to the box. Each player draws 2 Common Items.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If the Ancient One awakens, return this card to the box.

mythos_cards.title: The Story Continues…
mythos_cards.text: Shuffle the mythos deck, being sure to include this card in it. After the deck is shuffled, draw a new mythos card for the turn.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: "I cannot remember, I must not remember what I saw on that dark and foreboding night.."

mythos_cards.title: The Streets are Flooded
mythos_cards.text: All street areas are also aquatic locations while this card remains in play.

mythos_cards.title: The Tattered King
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place 1 Clue token on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it enters play).
mythos_cards.fail_condition: When the 5th clue token is place on this card, return this card to the box. Any investigator in a street area is devoured, as the Tattered King catches sight of him in the dead of night.

mythos_cards.title: The Tempest
mythos_cards.text: Luck checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Speed checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus, and investigators receive 1 extra movement point. All flying monsters in the Sky when this card enters play, or that move to the Sky while it remains in play, are returned to the monster cup.

mythos_cards.title: The Terrible Experiment
mythos_cards.text: When this card enters play, place 5 monsters from the cup on it. Any player may choose to fight one or more of these monsters while in the Miskatonic U. streets during the Arkham Encounter Phase. If defeated, they are claimed as monster trophies. These monsters do not move, are not considered on the board, and do not count against the monster limit.
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place a monster on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play).
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If there are no monsters on this card, return it to the box. Each player draws 1 Skill.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are 8 monsters on this card, return it to the box. Raise the terror level to 10 and place the monsters that were on it in play in the Miskatonic U. streets.

sections.Clarification: Any effects which would affect the monsters in the Miskatonic U. neighborhood do not apply to those placed on this card.

mythos_cards.title: The Trembling Earth
mythos_cards.text:
At the start of each Upkeep Phase while this card is in play, roll a die. On a 1, the terror level increases by 1.
While this card is in play, investigators receive 1 less movement point each turn.

mythos_cards.title: The Unraveling Tapestry
mythos_cards.text: Setup: Place 3 Clue tokens on this rumor.
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Each time a Gate opens, discard a Clue token from this rumor. Each time an Investigator casts a Spell, add a Clue token to this rumor.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: When there are 6 Clue tokens on this rumor, return it to the box and each investigator gains 1 Spell.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: When there are 0 Clue tokens on this rumor, return it to the box and each investigator loses 2 Sanity.

mythos_cards.title: The Veil is Strong
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, it takes one more open gate than usual to awaken the Ancient One.

mythos_cards.title: The Veil is Weak
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, it takes one more sealed gate than usual to win the game.

mythos_cards.title: Theater Experiences Renewal!
mythos_cards.text: Investigators in Arkham may immediately spend any amount of Sanity, up to the current terror level or the investigator's current Sanity, whichever is lower. For each point of Sanity spent, the player gains 1 Clue token.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The playhouse downtown has been struggling for months, and the recent run of the infamous play, "The King in Yellow," may revitalize it. But at what cost to those who watch it?

mythos_cards.title: Things of Darkness
mythos_cards.text: Ghouls, Formless Spawns, Shoggoths and Flying Polyps have their toughness increased by 1

mythos_cards.title: Tidal Wave!
mythos_cards.text: A crashing wave strikes the shore! All investigators in aquatic locations must pass a Fight (-1) check or lose 2 Stamina.

mythos_cards.title: Time After Time
mythos_cards.text: Hounds of Tindalos and Yithians have their toughness increased by 1. Gates to Another Time have their difficulty to be closed or sealed increased by 2

mythos_cards.title: To Conquer Death
mythos_cards.text: When this card enters play, place 3 Clue tokens on it. Each time an investigator passes a Horror check with 2 or more successes, add 1 Clue token to this card.
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: During the Mythos Phase, remove 1 Clue token from this card.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If the number of Clue tokens on this card is equal to the number of investigators plus 5, return this card to the box. Each investigator has his maximum Stamina increased by 1. Any player with 1 or more Injury cards (from the Dunwich Horror expansion) may choose 1 to discard.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are no Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. All monsters have the Endless ability and Undead monsters no longer count towards the monster limit.

mythos_cards.title: Tongue-Tied Teacher Taunted!
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: Each investigator with the most Clue tokens loses 1 Clue token. Each investigator with the fewest Clue tokens gains 1 Clue token.

mythos_cards.title: Tourists Flock to Arkham
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, investigators in a street area receive -1 on all Combat checks and gain 1 Sanity each time they pass a Combat check.

mythos_cards.title: Town Welcomes Visitors
mythos_cards.text: The first player chooses a dimensional symbol. Draw new monsters from the monster cup to replace each monster with that dimensional symbol in Arkham. (Ignore monsters in the Sky, but not the Outskirts.) Return monsters so replaced to the cup after all new monsters have been drawn.

mythos_cards.title: Train Robbers Strike Again!
mythos_cards.text: Any investigator currently in the Train Station or a depot location an an expansion game board must discard 2 items, if able.
mythos_cards.clue_location:
* Artists' Colony
* Devil Reef or The Unnamable

mythos_cards.title: Traveller Lost in Fog!
mythos_cards.text: The first player must immediately move to the Strange High House in the Mist.

mythos_cards.title: Two Sunsets
mythos_cards.text: Sneak and Will checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty
mythos_cards.flavor_text: A blurring effect in the atmosphere, which scientists believe may be caused by foreign weapons testing, has caused there to seem to be two suns, setting in rapid succession!

mythos_cards.title: Unending Darkness
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place 10 Clue tokens on this card. When a monster moves from a street area or a location to the Sky or into a vortex (either on the Dunwich Horror or Innsmouth Horror expansion game boards), remove 1 Clue token from this card.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If each investigator is Blessed, return this card to the box. Each investigator has his maximum Sanity increased by 1. Any player with 1 or more Madness cards (from the Dunwich Horror expansion) may choose 1 to discard.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If the number of Clue tokens on this card is less than the terror level, return it to the box. All players discard all of their Spells and then the Spell deck is returned to the box. Investigators may not use Spells for the rest of the game.

mythos_cards.title: Unpleasant Surprise!
mythos_cards.text: If the terror level is 8 or higher, or there is only one empty space left on the Ancient One's doom track, then the Ancient One immediately awakens.

mythos_cards.title: Unusual Moonrises
mythos_cards.text: Sneak and Lore checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. Will checks in Arkham are made at a -2 penalty.
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The moon seems overly large, and is close to the horizon from dusk to dawn, casting long shadows throughout the entire night. The scientists at Miskatonic University believe it to be an optical illusion.

mythos_cards.title: Unusual Phenomenon Sighted in Arkham!
mythos_cards.text: The first player must choose one inactive rift (if there are any). That rift's track immediately fills up and the rift opens.

mythos_cards.title: Uptown Hosts Famous Publisher
mythos_cards.text: Investigators in Arkham may immediately make a Will (-1) check. Any who pass may pay $3 to draw Spells as if they were receiving Magic Lessons at Ye Olde Magick Shoppe
mythos_cards.flavor_text: The Uptown Literati are hosting F. Tennyson Neely, British publisher of "the King in Yellow," at Ye Olde Magick Shoppe. Only the most elite are invited to hear him speak.

mythos_cards.title: Vigilante Guards the Night!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Downtown streets or locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Virulent Disease
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Place 1 Clue token on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it enters play. If a player ends his movement at St. Mary's Hospital, he may place a doom token on his investigator sheet.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: When the 3rd clue token is place on this card, return this card to the box and discard the doom tokens from the investigator sheets. All investigators who discard doom tokens are unaffected by the disease. Investigators who do not discard doom tokens are reduced to 1 Stamina and 1 Sanity due to the disease's ferocity.

mythos_cards.title: Vivisection Victim!
mythos_cards.edition_field: The Black Goat of the Woods
mythos_cards.text: The first player may choose a monster in Arkham and move it to the Science Building.

mythos_cards.title: Weakened Forces
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, all Magical Weapons have any bonuses they provide to Combat checks reduced by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Whateley Family Feud Escalates!
mythos_cards.text: All monsters in the Backwoods Country streets or locations are returned to the cup.

mythos_cards.title: Whateleys Accused of Witchcraft!
mythos_cards.text: The accusations come after someone (or something) releases 2 monsters into the Backwoods Country streets.

mythos_cards.title: Whippoorwills of Dunwich
mythos_cards.text: If an investigator is reduced to 0 Stamina or Sanity while this card is in play, roll a die. On a 1, the investigator is devoured as the whippoorwills catch his soul, and the terror level is increased by 1.

mythos_cards.title: Wildfire
mythos_cards.text: Each investigator in the Black Cave or Woods at the end of the Mythos Phase, as well as each investigator in Bishop's Brook Bridge, Cold Spring Glen, or Wizard's Hill on the Dunwich Horror expansion game board at the end of the Mythos Phase, loses 1 Stamina.
mythos_cards.clue_location: Cold Spring Glen or Hibb's Roadhouse

mythos_cards.title: Wild Visions Plague City!
mythos_cards.text: Investigators may set their skill sliders however they want when this card is drawn.

mythos_cards.title: Windy
mythos_cards.text: Sneak checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Speed checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus, and investigators receive 1 extra movement point. The Sky is considered to be adjacent to all unstable locations as well as all street areas.

mythos_cards.title: Witch Burning Anniversary!
mythos_cards.text: An ancient curse strikes Arkham, releasing 2 monsters into the Rivertown streets.

mythos_cards.title: Wolfsbane in Bloom
mythos_cards.text: Monsters with Magical Immunity are treated as having Magical Resistance instead and have their toughness increased by 1.
mythos_cards.clue_location: Esoteric Order of Dagon or Science Building

mythos_cards.title: World Torn Asunder
mythos_cards.text: When this card enters play, place 1 Clue token on it. Any player may discard a Blessing and a Skill while in the Miskatonic U. streets during the Arkham Encounter Phase to remove all Clue tokens from this card.
mythos_cards.ongoing_effect: Each time monsters with the moon dimensional symbol move, place a Clue token on this card.
mythos_cards.pass_condition: If there are no Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. Each investigator is restored to full Sanity and Stamina.
mythos_cards.fail_condition: If there are 3 Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. All 3 Rift tracks immediately fill up and all 3 rifts open.

sections.Clarification: Draw 3 Mythos Cards (discarding any that do not depict gates and re-drawing) to determine where the rifts appear.

mythos_cards.title: Worlds Drifting Apart
mythos_cards.text: While this card is in play, no rift tokens may be placed on the Rift track.

mythos_cards.title: Yuggoth in Retrograde
mythos_cards.text: Investigators receive +1 to Fight and Lore checks to close Gates.
